name: claude-usage-bar
description: Shows the token, prompt cache, cost and graft figures of the live Claude Code sessions on this machine in the status bar, with a details pane for all of them.

claudeUsageBar.warnTokens.description: Context size in tokens at which the status bar item turns to the warning color.

claudeUsageBar.alertTokens.description: Context size in tokens at which the status bar item turns to the error color. Keep it above claudeUsageBar.warnTokens.
